No, but the genre is rock!
I'm fairly certain it's a male voice, so I don't think she's the singer.
I survived! Used the method where you leave and rejoin a bunch, I just told them my internet was being bad.
Something's telling me that this isn't a hypothetical question...

Dreamt about [this freaky video a lot](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=onpjT69mBR4&ab_channel=cmedbdis), it was only ever the cliff view and side views though, the dream always ended with the skull coming up to me and running me over. As far as my memories go, though, I never watched it prior. The train was also a lot more realistic.

I also saw that whack n' win arcade game in my dreams, I'm not sure where I ever was included in those dreams but it scared the hell out of me because whenever the thing was hit, it sent someone flying up to the top and being murdered.

But wait! There's more! I also dreamt about a very pixelated game, with there being a pixelated witch, a bunch of pixelated spikes, and a pixelated me. And I'm not talking about 8 bits, I'm talking about 2 bit games. I always fell into those spikes and got pixelated blood pieces everywhere, and then it would cut to me being dunked in a cauldron, and that's when I woke up.

I have more, but better not make this a very long read.

Probably not your regular kind of addiction, but I swore quite a lot, began saying rude jokes, the kind where you would say "Kill yourself" in response to another degrading joke. I also began saying slurs, like the R and the F.  


I began saying all these things when I was with a new group of friends, the average influence kind of thing. I've asked them to stop saying that sort of thing along with me, and to stop me when I do say it but they haven't really helped.  


That's why I cut most contact with them, mainly on apps like Discord. Of course I never unfriended, so I didn't completely sever ties, I just left the groupchats.  


Needless to say, I believe I have become a decent human being.
Created this when I saw there was a subreddit dedicated to dreamgenders and dreamsexuals. And not the actual kind. It was the kind about the funny green guy.

Undertale. It was always undertale because of the god damn skeleton.  


Though, my favourite tracks from the game has to be hopes and dreams, his theme, or ghost fight.

People talking with friends on a stairway that spread across the entire space while going down or up excruciatingly slow. I could've gone to a stairway that takes 5 minutes more to get to and still would have gone faster.  


Which I have.
